title: Actual rational direct image and its normalized scalar comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a morphism $f:X\to Y$ between Noetherian finite-dimensional schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible. At every finite coefficient field $E$, assume the actual integral derived direct image of [def-weil-derived-direct-image] preserves the bounded constructible complete objects of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Define $D_E$ by restricting that actual integral operation and applying the raw rationalization of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. For a coherent morphism $D$ of the scalar systems [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension] with components $D_E$, define its normalized direct-image comparison predicate as follows: for every $E\subset F$, conjugating its comparison by the integral-to-rational scalar comparisons gives the localized canonical ambient direct-image scalar mate on every integral representative. This includes $E=F$. The induced functor on the pair category [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category] is the coherent-family descent functor, with its usual comparison-conjugated representative formula.

def pbcDescentDirectImage {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
